QueryString.value: SELECT Organization, Project, coalesce(Repository, '') AS Repository, toInt64(BuildId) AS BuildId, coalesce(Pipeline, '') AS Pipeline, coalesce(Role, '') AS Role, coalesce(Reason, '') AS Reason, coalesce(Result, '') AS Result, coalesce(Environment, '') AS Environment, coalesce(Version, '') AS Version, coalesce(SourceBranch, '') AS SourceBranch, coalesce(TargetBranch, '') AS TargetBranch, if(coalesce(PullRequestId, 0) > 0, toInt64(PullRequestId), NULL) AS PullRequestId, if(coalesce(ParentBuildId, 0) > 0, toInt64(ParentBuildId), NULL) AS ParentBuildId, coalesce(Agents, '') AS Agents, if(coalesce(Agents, '') = '', 'Unknown', if(match(Agents, '(?i)(runner|linux|lnx|ubuntu)'), 'Linux', 'Windows')) AS Platform, coalesce(ReleaseOutcome, '') AS ReleaseOutcome, toFloat64(DurationSeconds) AS DurationSeconds, toFloat64(QueueSeconds) AS QueueSeconds, toFloat64(PackageCount) AS PackageCount, toFloat64(FailedTests) AS FailedTests, toDateTime(Started, 'UTC') AS StartedAt, toDateTime(Finished, 'UTC') AS FinishedAt FROM ADOTelemetry_PipelineRun FINAL
